description: List Withings sleep summaries with common sleep fields. Requires user.activity scope. Not medical advice.

after.description: Inclusive start bound. Converted to Withings startdate (epoch) or startdateymd (YYYY-MM-DD) per action.

all_pages.description: Fetch multiple pages up to max_pages.

before.description: Inclusive end bound. Converted to Withings enddate (epoch) or enddateymd (YYYY-MM-DD) per action.

limit.description: Upstream page-size hint and local output cap used for pagination safety.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch when all_pages is true.

privacy_mode.description: Optional per-call privacy override. Defaults to WITHINGS_PRIVACY_MODE or structured. raw returns upstream Withings JSON. summary minimizes sensitive health and profile details.

name: withings_list_sleep_summary
title: Withings Sleep Summaries
